met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 76°E to the north of Lat. 28°N.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Bangladesh & neighbourhoodat 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in easterlies from Gulf of Mannar to Southwest Bay of Bengal off Tamil Nadu coast at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gujarat & adjoining Southwest Rajasthan at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Lakshadweep & neighbourhoodat 0.9 km above mean sea level.
